name: measure-object
title: Measure an object
description: Look at an object and report its current axis-aligned size.
use_when: The size or distance of an object must be known before choosing a grasp or place.

not_to_be_confused_with.identify: identify returns the category, measure the size and distance.

size_m.description: World-frame size [dx, dy, dz] in metres.

postconditions.meaning: The robot recorded the object's size from a view with the object in the head camera.
Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
